items.title: Josiah "Cie" Frazier Interview
items.q: I bought the bass drum separately from C.G. Kahn. At that time it was at 116, I believe, Crown of that street.

ctx.x: What kind of a drum set did you get in the beginning?

The first drum I ever owned was a Ludwig. Ludwig drum. How big was the bass drum? The bass drum in them days was 14 by 28. I bought the bass drum separately from C.G. Kahn. At that time it was at 116, I believe, Crown of that street. And the snare drum I bought that separately by a mail order house called the Willis and Music People out of Chicago.
Was that a Kahn, I mean Ludwig too?
